metadata.neutral_citation: TA XUONG v. THE INCORPORATED OWNERS OF SUN HING BUILDING [1997] HKCFI 557; [1997] 4 HKC 171
metadata.case_name: TA XUONG v. THE INCORPORATED OWNERS OF SUN HING BUILDING

injuries.description: Quadriplegia / tetraplegia (spinal cord injury resulting in paralysis of all four limbs)
source: This Plaintiff falls within the Frankel Grade A, B, C of quadriplegia
The quadriplegic state involves paralysis of all four limbs.
injuries.icd_description: Certain specified injuries of cervical spinal cord

manifestations.description: He has head and facial movement
Persistent head and shoulder pain and spasms
Depression is acute and likely to be long lasting
Entirely dependent upon others for every action essential to survival
No upper body mobility except head (no upper body mobility whatever, with the exception of his head)

treatments_received.treatment: Physiotherapy (initial: thrice weekly for 12 weeks then once weekly for following 12 weeks)
source: The first period of thrice weekly sessions for a 12 week period is agreed at $28,800. It is reduced to once weekly for the following 12 weeks, at a cost of $800 a session.

treatments_received.treatment: Occupational therapy (initial weekly sessions for 6 months then monthly)
source: For the initial period of weekly sessions for 6 months I allow $10,972. Thereafter his requirements are once a month.
Psychiatric Treatment & Counselling - This is agreed in the sum of $108,000 and features in Dr. C.K. Wong's report.
Family Therapy - This is supported by Dr. C.K. Wong's report. ... I allow the claim at $45,000.

treatments_received.treatment: In-patient psychiatric treatment (one 3-week period per year)
source: In-Patient Psychiatric Treatment - This provides for one 3-week period per year. The annual cost is $97,020.

treatments_received.treatment: Urological consultations (two specialist urological consultations per year)
source: Dr. George Koo considers ... there should be two specialist urological consultations per year.
Case Manager - I have no doubt that this is essential. ... $93,600 X 18 =$1,684,800.

treatments_received.treatment: Nursing care (two carers to cover 24 hour period: day China Trained Nurse and night Chinese Care Assistant)
source: Nursing Care - I accept the evidence that two carers to cover the 24 hour period are necessary. ... The annual cost is $231,410 X 18 = $4,165,380.
A Chinese Care Assistant is appropriate for the night shift. The annual cost is $151,840 X 18 = $2,733,120.
For the rest of his life he will need this on a monthly basis. ... This will cost $9,600 p.a. X 17.5 = $168,000.
Thereafter his requirements are once a month. ... $5,064 per annum X 17.5 = $88,620.
Psychiatric Treatment & Counselling - This is agreed in the sum of $108,000

treatments_future.treatment: Annual in-patient psychiatric treatment (3 weeks per year)
source: In-Patient Psychiatric Treatment ... The annual cost is $97,020. The overall cost is $97,020 X 18 = $1,746,360.
Urological Investigation Consultation ... $14,000 per annum X 18 = $252,000.

treatments_future.treatment: Provision and maintenance of aids & equipment (see schedule of Future Aids & Equipment)
source: There are 53 items set out in the Plaintiffs updated Schedule of Damages. ... The total of these sums in the schedule is - $3,300,203.

losses.description: Paralysis of all four limbs; tetraplegic state
Requires assistance for movement; virtually helpless and totally dependent
Entirely dependent upon others for every action essential to survival

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: The physical relationship in a marriage has gone for all time
The ability to share in the bringing up of children has gone
No prospect of a worthwhile substitute career
